sonnet.problem: Card 4 already asked and revealed that the people have not listened. Verse 4 repeats that same point ("you have not listened"), so this true/false re-asks a fact the baker has already been shown, and the answer is easy to infer from card 4.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
